items.name: 01-airing-cupboard-hero
items.prompt: A British airing cupboard on an upstairs landing with its single painted cream door wide open on visible hinges. Inside, on the floor at the left, stands one white factory-insulated hot water cylinder with copper pipes running up the back wall. Slatted pine shelves are fixed to the side and back walls on wooden battens; the lowest shelf starts well above the top of the cylinder, leaving clear space around it and its pipes. The shelves hold neatly folded white and sage green towels and bedding in tidy stacks.
